stories.title: Leading the Way
stories.detail: Kirsty Kochanski & Christopher Kochanski nose in front of Kylie Barac & Jesse Barac by 1, nerves well and truly in play.

stories.title: Family Affair
stories.detail: The Barac household pairing Kylie Barac & Jesse Barac card 40 gross, 29 net, and no family feud yet.

stories.title: Keeping it in the Family
stories.detail: Kirsty Kochanski & Christopher Kochanski keep the Kochanski name on the leaderboard and the ribbing in the car.

stories.title: Countback Territory
stories.detail: 30.75 net for Narelle Jones & Kim Robinson, 30.75 net for Jodie Tancredi & Sharon McLoughlin, and one very nervous scorer.

stories.title: Too Close to Call
stories.detail: 0 all between Olivia Skellern & Amy Green and Geoff O'Hare & Andrew Wise, time to audit those back nines.

stories.title: Pure Strikers
stories.detail: Low markers Geoff O'Hare & Andrew Wise squeeze 0 out of a measly 0.

stories.title: Strokes to Spare
stories.detail: +35.5 on the sheet for Therese Woolnough & Annette Lamont, courtesy of a very friendly 18.5.

stories.title: Strokes in the Bank
stories.detail: Jodie Tancredi & Sharon McLoughlin lean on 17.25 and come up with 30.75 net after a 48 gross.

stories.title: In the Mix
stories.detail: 36.25 net has Kane Harding & Andrew Wise right in the guts of the field, 42 gross and no drama.

stories.title: In the Thick of It
stories.detail: Patricia Booth & Kim Bentley are parked comfortably mid-pack on +36, doing no harm at all.

stories.title: Best-Ball Buddies
stories.detail: 45 gross, 33.5 net, and Emma McMahon & Monica Harrison blaming whoever hit second.

stories.title: Better Together
stories.detail: A bit of give and take and Kylie Barac & Jesse Barac end up with +29.

stories.title: Bringing Up the Rear
stories.detail: Lorraine Thompson & Erica Coghlan finish down the list on 44.75 net, 62 gross, spirits entirely undented.
